name: FIV footman droid
description: The FIV footman droid was a droid model manufactured by Tac-Spec. It had humanoid proportions with a reinforced chassis at the chest, a pelvic servomotor and precision-articulated limbs. It had blue plating and white sensors. A footman droid served Bo-Katan Kryze at Kryze Castle on the planet Kalevala.
